=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1211-1213 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The credential redaction `sed` patterns fail to reliably sanitize push probe output, leaving some credentials exposed in workflow logs.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers independently found that the URL/basic-auth and `x-access-token` redaction logic breaks on common cases such as empty credentials, case variants, URL-encoded separators, and regex/pattern interactions; severity is the highest reported across reviewers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1179 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The temporary probe file is only removed on the normal path and lacks trap-based cleanup for interrupts or early exits.
  WHY: Reviewers noted the `mktemp` file can be left behind if the job is cancelled or exits early, and all reports agreed this is a cleanup gap.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1210 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `printf '%s' "${push_probe_output}"` can strip trailing newlines from the probe output.
  WHY: Reviewers flagged that the current formatting may mangle or truncate logged output, though the impact was rated low and confidence varied.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py:186-191 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test only checks for source-string presence and does not verify that redaction actually works at runtime.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the assertions can pass even when the sanitization regex is broken, so the test provides false confidence rather than behavioral coverage.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1212 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The second URL-redaction pattern can consume already-redacted output and collapse the credential shape.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that the sequential `sed` expressions can re-match the first pattern’s output, changing `https://[REDACTED]:[REDACTED]@` into `https://[REDACTED]@`; severity reflects the highest report.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1211 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The basic-auth redaction pattern does not handle empty usernames or passwords.
  WHY: Reviewers independently cited URLs like `https://user:@` and `https://:pass@` remaining unredacted because the `+` quantifiers require non-empty credential parts.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1213 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `x-access-token` redaction is case-sensitive and misses common capitalization variants.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the pattern only matches lowercase `x-access-token`, so uppercase or mixed-case variants can leak; severity follows the highest reported.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1211-1213 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: URL-encoded credential separators bypass the redaction patterns.
  WHY: Reviewers found that `%3A` and `%40` variants are not matched by the literal `:` and `@` expressions, so encoded credentials can escape sanitization.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1211-1214 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The regex character class syntax around `[:space:]` is malformed in the redaction expressions.
  WHY: One reviewer said the POSIX class syntax is invalid and can prevent matching, while another called it a critical flaw in the same redaction block; severity is kept at the highest reported and the disagreement is that one review also treated the issue as overlapping with broader redaction failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1215 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `x-access-token` redaction does not handle the common space-separated header-style format.
  WHY: The reviewer reported that `x-access-token: ghp_...` is not matched because the character class excludes spaces, allowing token leakage in typical git output.
